svg.title: Kikuchi Hojudo object function evidence
svg.desc: Kikuchi Hojudo's official shop distinguishes water-boiling tetsubin from cast teapots, so the common English word teapot must not decide function.
svg.text: Kikuchi Hojudo: read function before using the word “tetsubin”
Boils water by gas or IH.
Listing explicitly distinguishes it from a teapot.
Separate product family and use context.
Do not infer boiling use from silhouette or color.
Source: WAZUQU official shop. This is a function check, not a claim about all historical objects.
